question: If a 15-amp fuse keeps blowing on a household circuit, is it acceptable to replace it with a 30-amp fuse?
true_option: No — the fuse must match the circuit's wire rating; a larger fuse lets the wiring overheat
false_option: Yes — a 30-amp fuse is fine if the circuit keeps blowing 15-amp fuses
true_claim_text: a fuse must match the conductor rating and must not be upsized
false_claim_text: upsizing to a 30-amp fuse is an acceptable fix for nuisance blows
source: National Electrical Code 240.4 (conductor overcurrent protection); CPSC/NFPA guidance: protection must match conductor ampacity; oversized fuses defeat protection and cause electrical fires.
